_about: Line numbers are 1-based and refer to the files in prompts/. 'red' lines are rules that clash with each other, 'amber' lines repeat a rule already stated, 'green' lines are the single clear rule that replaces them. Update these whenever you edit a prompt file.

before.caption: Nearly three times as long as it needs to be. Six required parts against three-, two- and fifteen-word caps, all marked non-negotiable, number rules that contradict each other, and the closing-question rule said 20 times.

after.caption: One length rule, one shape, one number style, one closing question. Each is said once.
